h2: Visual testing in Dallas: VT certification, pipe inspection and where VT is required
html:
Visual testing in Dallas: VT certification, pipe inspection and where VT is required

Visual testing searches from Dallas–Fort Worth come from three groups: technicians who want VT certification, owners who need visual inspection of piping or pipelines, and fabricators who must record weld visual acceptance. Atlantis trains VT Level I and Level II technicians online to ASNT SNT-TC-1A, and sends VT inspectors from Houston to North Texas sites, with reports reviewed by an ASNT NDT Level III.

VT certification for DFW technicians. Under SNT-TC-1A, VT certification is issued by your employer against its written practice once you have the required training hours, experience and examinations, including a practical. Atlantis provides the theory online, the practical arrangements and simulator practice. The AWS Certified Welding Inspector credential is a separate scheme with its own examination and is not part of the Atlantis course list. When a DFW job posting asks for "VT Level II", it means the SNT-TC-1A route. Start with visual testing training, see how the levels build on the NDT Level II training page, and practice on the Practical NDT visual testing simulator. Local enrollment details are on the Dallas NDT training page.

VT on process piping. External visual inspection of in-service piping under API 570 looks for coating breakdown, corrosion at pipe supports and shoes, leaking flanges and valve packing, damaged insulation jacketing and other signs of corrosion under insulation. Those findings decide where thickness readings and insulation removal go next, so a careful visual survey keeps the UT scope smaller.

VT on pipelines. At an excavation, visual examination records coating condition, external corrosion, dents and gouges before any measurement is taken. Which regulator's rules apply depends on whether the line is intrastate, under the Railroad Commission of Texas, or interstate, under PHMSA. The operator's procedure says which findings must be photographed, measured and reported.

Boilers, aircraft and fabrication. Owners preparing for a Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation boiler certificate inspection can book remote visual examination of drums, headers and tubes, so the Authorized Inspection Agency's commissioned inspector has images to review; Atlantis supplies the NDE and does not perform the certificate inspection. At Love Field, Southwest Airlines' maintenance base works on its Boeing 737 fleet, and in Fort Worth, Bell Textron builds rotorcraft; aviation visual inspection follows the manufacturer's maintenance data, and aerospace production work requires NAS 410 personnel certification. In fabrication shops, visual acceptance of every weld comes before any volumetric method.

  • Direct visual examination to ASME Section V Article 9 with stated lighting and viewing distance
  • Remote visual with borescopes and crawler cameras for drums, headers and closed piping
  • API 570 external surveys that mark corrosion under insulation and support damage
  • Weld visual acceptance to AWS D1.1 or the referencing construction code

For site work, the method page is visual testing, and wider scopes start from NDT inspection services or corrosion under insulation inspection. Send the line list or asset list and access details through the Dallas VT request, or ask about courses through the Dallas VT training enquiry.
